summary: Dedicated pool queue saturation during autoscaler oscillation
description:
Issue summary:
Multiple dedicated pools show rapid scale up/down and spikes in queue wait time. Customers report intermittent timeouts and throughput drops.

Impact:
Dedicated tier degraded performance; no data loss.

Environment:
prod us-west; autoscaling policy=balanced.

Hypothesis:
Cooldown/stabilization regression causing capacity thrash and momentary GPU shortages.
comments: 2026-01-09 07:49 PT (Camila Reyes): Seeing autoscaler flapping across 3 pools. Queue wait p95 > 6s.
2026-01-09 08:02 PT (David Kim): Found cooldown change in IaC; rolling back to previous setting.
2026-01-09 08:19 PT (Grace O'Connor): Suggest pinning minimum GPU floor temporarily to stop oscillation.
2026-01-09 08:31 PT (David Kim): Rollback applied; queue stabilizing.
resolution: Reverted autoscaler cooldown change; temporarily pinned minimum GPU floor for affected pools; documented follow-ups in postmortem.
